## Summary

Describe the contribution and its intended use.

For new or changed mathematical results, provide or link to the
natural-language statement, including relevant definitions, assumptions,
and conclusions. Add references where applicable.

For existing results, highlight changes to definitions, assumptions,
conclusions, or public interfaces.

Mention any implementation choices that would help reviewers.

## Checks and review notes

List checks run, or refer to available CI results.
Mention any dependencies or questions needing reviewer attention.
